notes: monthlyLimitUsd: the monthly spend limit the owner set on the PRODUCTION Anthropic Console workspace (key ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). deploy.yml passes it to the Worker as ANTHROPIC_MONTHLY_LIMIT_USD (spend tiers use min(memo formula L, this)), and a change to this file on master redeploys. Raise the Console limit first, then this file. evalMonthlyLimitUsd: for the record, the limit on the separate EVAL workspace (key ANTHROPIC_EVAL_API_KEY; memo §3.3 dev and eval allowance; staging grades with it too). The KPI Routine proposes raises as PRs (memo §3.4); the owner changes the Console and merges (business/online/owner-setup.md 2-1)
